scope: Poll application readiness every250ms during delivering/downloading/starting; retain1000ms build/provisioning/stop cadence and1/2/4s transient-failure backoff. Six new behavioral cases execute the real client with deterministic timers, alongside14 previous client regressions.
behavioralCoverage: Newly healthy app opens within500ms in each active delivery phase and subsequent polling ends.
Transient failure during fast startup polling retains1000ms first retry delay and cancels after navigation.
Stop during delivery cancels fast polling and cannot open the product.
Existing authorization denial, stale responses, aborted reads, page exit, manual recovery and no creation retries remain covered.
